prepareBoundedIntegrationEnvelope.temperatureReason: Every outbound integration delivery decodes and re-encodes its supported JSON envelope.
prepareBoundedIntegrationEnvelope.reason: Literal integrationDeliveryPayload algorithm over the proven owned JSON primitives: payload copy when there are no previous values, a non-object or invalid payload, or invalid previous values; otherwise decode, set previousValues and re-encode with encoding/json semantics (duplicate keys, large/small numbers, HTML escaping, U+2028, deep nesting, 1e999 fallback). Decode and wire lifetimes are separately owned and the wire bytes stay admitted until the network call ends. TestScaleP21SW202IntegrationEnvelopeDifferential and TestScaleP21SW228IntegrationEnvelopeFallbacksAndOwnership compare bytes and nil/empty identity with the literal function and pin release and cancellation; SW510 and SW228 near-limit compare the envelope actually sent.
